defense_news.title: Medal of Honor recipient Dakota Meyer tapped as Barracks Task Force senior advisor
defense_news.summary: Medal of Honor recipient Dakota Meyer was selected as Secretary Hegseth's senior advisor and will visit military installations across the country.

defense_news.title: US Army support for Golden Dome missile shield takes shape
defense_news.summary: A U.S. Army air defense unit has been "earmarked" for support of the Golden Dome for America project, an Army official confirmed.

defense_news.title: US Air Force F-22 pilot controls unmanned FQ-44 in flight
defense_news.summary: The fighter jet’s pilot served as an airborne “quarterback” and gave high-level directives to an Anduril-made Collaborative Combat Aircraft.

defense_news.title: China built more than twice naval tonnage of US in 2024-25: Euronaval
defense_news.summary: China built more than twice the naval tonnage of the U.S. in the 2024-25 period, narrowing the gap between the two countries’ navies, a new report says.

geo_news.title: Dışişleri Bakanı Fidan, Libyalı yetkililer Dibeybe ve Hafter ile telefonda görüştü
geo_news.summary: Dışişleri Bakanı Hakan Fidan, Libya Ulusal Birlik Hükümeti Başbakanı Abdulhamid Dibeybe ve Libya Ulusal Ordusu Genel Komutan Yardımcısı Saddam Hafter ile telefonda görüştü.

geo_news.title: Ankara'da belediye otobüsünün yaya üst geçidinin ayağına çarpması sonucu 24 kişi yaralandı
